newsitem.title: UK: MMC ruling on BG nearly complete - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: MMC ruling on BG nearly complete - newspaper.

text.p: The Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) report on BG Plc is on course for completion on Monday, the Times reported on Wednesday.

BG, owner of the pipeline network of the former British Gas, is locked in dispute with industry regulator Ofgas over the watchdog's proposals for a new pricing regime for BG's pipeline operator TransCo.
The MMC has been vetting Ofgas's proposals since October after they had been rejected by BG.

At the time, the company argued the proposals, which also seek a 20 percent cut this year in TransCo's charges to gas suppliers, would leave it with insufficient funds to maintain an efficient and reliable pipeline network.
